Trustworthy review: digital legacy verdict

By the Afterkeep research team · Reviewed on 15 Oct 2026 · Independent: sponsors can't buy a verdict · How we rate

Verdict: A family document organiser with an encrypted vault and legacy access options. It organises information; it doesn't say it writes wills. Best for: Families who want one organised, shareable place for important documents.

Frequently asked questions

Is Trustworthy good for digital legacy planning?

A family document organiser with an encrypted vault and legacy access options. It organises information; it doesn't say it writes wills.

Who is Trustworthy best for?

Families who want one organised, shareable place for important documents.

How much does Trustworthy cost?

Free plan; Silver $10, Gold $20, Platinum $40 a month, paid annually. Check current pricing.

What are the downsides of Trustworthy?

Doesn't state that it creates wills; Countries supported not stated; Advanced features need paid plans.

What are alternatives to Trustworthy?

Alternatives in the same category include Trust & Will, GoodTrust, Everplans.
